title: Domain Tecnaria connector factory

sourceOracles.coverage: Source factory is consumed in Tecnaria connector construction; direct delegation, serialization, inheritance and delegated error parity are covered by the independent live test

independentValidation.method: Strict declaration consumer coverage and independently executed pinned JavaScript versus built TypeScript factory modules, including exact delegated JSON, Unicode, inherited instanceof behavior, default construction and delegated unsupported/error paths.

tolerances.serializedParity: exact JSON serialization of the delegated TecnariaConnector result
tolerances.numericParity: exact equality of all delegated normalized connector values
tolerances.publicStrings: exact equality plus Unicode code-point equality

parityDifferences: The slice preserves the source factory's direct TecnariaConnector delegation, returned subclass identity, defaults, serialization and delegated errors.
No additional factory behavior or connector/application functionality is introduced.
engineeringFunctionality: Generic Tecnaria connector factory delegation only.
